title: A new project's gate is red and hides the cause
what: A failed step's summary and gate log carry its last error line whatever its wording (for example 'No module named pytest'); setup checks that the stack's test tool is installed and, when not, its to-do says the gate will be red until bin/ci is edited and names the step.
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. Template bin/ci for a python stack runs `python3 -m pytest -q`; with no pytest in that python the gate is red with 'No module named pytest' only in .ci/ci.log: the printed summary ('ci: tests FAILED') and the committed gate log show no cause because the step keeps only lines matching FAIL|error|Error. setup's to-do says 'bin/check: check the python steps it was given' but not that the gate stays red until bin/ci is tailored.
failing_case: Fresh python project, no pytest installed: `relay setup`, then `relay gate -- --quick` prints 'ci: tests FAILED' and the gate log has no line naming the missing module.
pass_cases: the gate log of that run contains 'No module named pytest'
setup's to-do names the red step when the test tool is missing
a green template step is unchanged
